what: tur-install-engine check on a computer with too little memory, from a damaged medium

text: [note]  Secure Boot in the firmware: enabled
[STOP]  Installation image on this medium: damaged

blocking.text: This computer has 2.0 GiB of usable memory. TUR needs at least 3.0 GiB.

The installation image on this medium cannot be used: 1 of 72 files of the installation image are damaged. Write the medium again, to another USB stick if you can, and compare its checksum before you do.

payload_detail: 1 of 72 files of the installation image are damaged
